purpose: Refresh redirect: an absolute url= target in the Refresh header must be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: Refresh navigates to an absolute external target, which allows open-redirect behaviour that Location-based filters do not examine.

limitations: Observation mode: the fixture is a synthetic HTTP observation object, not a live request or a real target.
The case proves the declared DAST check evaluates as stated on this observation; it does not prove exploitability.

provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence
